title: Combination of chemical cross-linking and pull-down assay to study transient protein-protein interactions
protocol: Grow 200 ml yeast cells expressing V5-His6 tagged protein in YPG to an A600 of approximately 0.6.
Incubate cells at 30°C in the dark for one hour after UV or mock treatment.
Add formaldehyde directly to the culture to achieve a final concentration of 1%.
Quench cross-linking by adding 0.5 M glycine to the culture.
Harvest cells and wash them with cold Tris-buffered saline followed by cold lysis buffer.
Resuspend approximately 0.5 ml yeast cells in 1 ml of lysis buffer containing 1 mM phenylmethylsulfonyl fluoride and protease inhibitor mixture.
Disrupt the cells by vortexing in the presence of 0.5 ml glass beads.
Sonicate the lysate to ensure DNA fragments are less than 1 kb.
Centrifuge the lysate for 20 min at 10,000 g.
Incubate 0.5 ml cell-free extracts with 0.1 ml Ni-NTA-Agarose beads overnight at 4 °C.
Transfer the beads to a 2 ml tube and wash three times with 1.5 ml lysis buffer.
Wash the beads three times with 1.5 ml of lysis buffer containing 20 mM imidazole.
Wash the beads twice with 1.5 ml TE (10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA).
Transfer the beads to a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube with TE and pellet.
Add SDS-PAGE sample buffer (2x, 0.1 ml) to the bead pellet.
Reverse cross-links by boiling for 20 min.
Analyze samples by Western blotting using antibodies specific for DNA repair proteins Rad4 and Rad23.
Strip the PVDF membrane and reprobe with V5 antibody.
Use Snf6-V5His6 and/or LacZ-V5His6 as loading controls.
Incubate Human IgG-Agarose beads (0.1 ml) with 0.5 ml cell-free extracts overnight at 4°C.
Transfer the beads to a 2 ml tube and wash three times with 1.5 ml lysis buffer.
Wash the beads twice with 1.5 ml of TE (10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA).
Resuspend 0.01 ml washed Ni-NTA-Agarose beads in 0.2 ml 1X DNase I buffer.
Treat the resuspended beads with 5 units of DNase I for 3 hours at 37°C.
Wash the treated beads twice with 1.5 ml of TE (10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.0, 1 mM EDTA).
Incubate cell-free extracts (0.5 ml, approximately 20 mg/ml protein) with 0.1 ml Ni-NTA-Agarose beads overnight at 4 °C in the presence of ethidium bromide (from 0.05 to 0.5 mg/ml).
Wash Ni-NTA-agarose beads gently three times with buffer containing 25 mM HEPES-KOH, pH 7.5, 50 mM or 200 mM KCl, and 10% glycerol.
